glosses: coverage (the amount by which something or someone is covered)
coverage, reception, signal (the extent to which a television radio or internet signal reaches)

examples.text: En esta zona no hay cobertura.
examples.en: There's no cellphone coverage in this area.

examples.text: El trébol es un buen cultivo de cobertura.
